subject: Kickoff: AWS Channel Private Offer & reseller enablement — CloudResell
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:02:00Z
Subject: Kickoff: AWS Channel Private Offer & reseller enablement — CloudResell

Hi Tom —

Great to meet last week. Quick follow-up to start a short enablement sprint so we can get the Channel Private Offer (CPPO) wired and the SKU/entitlement mapping completed for CloudResell. Requested attendees are on CC.

Goal: have an actionable CPPO ready for AWS review and a preliminary entitlement mapping by end of next week (9/19).

Key asks from our side to kick off: 
- Your AWS account number(s) and reseller entity name for the CPPO.
- A primary billing contact + email for invoice routing.
- Any special pass-through discount or margin constraints we should be aware of.

I've attached a brief checklist (CloudResell_CPPO_Checklist.xlsx) and a sample entitlement CSV to make the mapping faster.

Proposed next steps:
1) Tom + CloudResell to confirm account/entity info by Tue 9/14.
2) Internal mapping session Wed 9/15 (30 min) with Ben and Priyom to align SKUs and entitlement rows.
3) Redwood prepares CPPO LOI and DocuSign by Thu 9/16 for CloudResell review.

Can you confirm those deadlines work? If so, I'll send a calendar invite for the mapping session.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0172

[Attachment: CloudResell_CPPO_Checklist.xlsx]

From: Tom Nguyen <tom@cloudresell.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: account-exec@cloudresell.com
Date: 2026-09-12T17:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS Channel Private Offer & reseller enablement — CloudResell

Soojin —

Thanks, excited to get this moving. Quick answers below: 
- AWS Account: 123456789012 (primary) — entity: CloudResell, Inc.
- Billing contact: Lisa Park, lisa.park@cloudresell.com, +1 206-555-0109
- Margin: target reseller margin is 18% gross; if Redwood needs a higher list we can discuss exceptions for committed SKUs.

We reviewed your checklist and have a couple questions on entitlement granularity: we sell both “platform seat” and “consumption” SKUs to different buyer segments — do you prefer separate CPPO SKUs or a single consolidated offer with mapped entitlements? Also we have an internal PO cadence (monthly net 30) — want to ensure DocuSign and invoicing align.

We can confirm the account/entity by Tue 9/14 and join the mapping session. Calendar invite for Wed works; please set it for 11:00 PT.

Thanks —

Tom
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudResell, Inc.
[Attachment: entitlement-questions.docx]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS Channel Private Offer & reseller enablement — CloudResell

Tom —

Thanks for the quick turn. Short answers inline below and a couple of asks before the mapping session: 

- SKU strategy: We recommend separate SKUs for platform seat vs consumption if you expect different entitlement rules or billing cadence — it simplifies entitlement mapping and helps with observability in the Marketplace. If CloudResell prefers a single SKU for GTM simplicity, we can still map multiple entitlements under the same SKU but it makes invoice splits more manual.

- PO cadence: monthly net 30 is fine. We'll surface that in the LOI. Please confirm if CloudResell needs consolidated invoicing or per-account invoicing (consolidated preferred).

- Action: can you populate the attached entitlement-mapping-draft.csv with the first 12 SKUs you plan to campaign? That will allow Ben/Priyom to validate provisioning flows.

I’m scheduling the mapping session for Wed 2026-09-15 11:00 PT and sending a calendar invite now. Agenda: 1) Review mapping CSV (10m), 2) Entitlement provisioning paths (10m), 3) Invoicing & DocuSign timeline (10m).

Ben/Priyom — heads-up: please review the CSV before Wed; Priyom will own entitlement validation, Ben will own CPPO activation and AWS handoffs.

Best,
Soojin

[Attachment: entitlement-mapping-draft.csv]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS Channel Private Offer & reseller enablement — CloudResell

On Wed, Sep 15, 2026 at 11:00 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Agenda: 1) Review mapping CSV (10m), 2) Entitlement provisioning paths (10m), 3) Invoicing & DocuSign timeline (10m).

Thanks everyone — quick notes from our mapping call and open items: 
- Priyom verified the sample entitlement rows; provisioning will use the Customer Entitlement API and requires the reseller AWS Account ID in the 'primary_account' column.
- We flagged one SKU that requires per-seat license keys (platform-seat-v2) — CloudResell should confirm whether they will pass seat counts via API or via invoice reconciliation.
- Vanessa: I'll need your help to track the billing entity changes — CloudResell said they prefer consolidated invoicing.
- Next doc step: I uploaded an initial LOI to DocuSign and attached the DocuSign link in this thread. Once Tom confirms the mapping CSV and consolidated invoice preference, we'll push for signature and start AWS submission.

Open items for CloudResell: 
1) Populate entitlement-mapping-draft.csv with 12 SKUs (due 9/16 EOD).
2) Confirm seat-count passing method for platform SKUs.
3) Approve consolidated invoicing.

I'll follow up with a short checklist for AWS evidence after signature.

Ben Carter
Director, Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: DocuSign-CPPO-LOI.pdf | DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/ABC123456]

From: Tom Nguyen <tom@cloudresell.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: account-exec@cloudresell.com, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS Channel Private Offer & reseller enablement — CloudResell

Ben / Soojin —

Thanks for the run-through. We've uploaded the 12 SKUs to the CSV and confirmed consolidated invoicing is the preference. For the platform-seat-v2 SKU, we'll pass seat counts via the Entitlement API (preferred) — we've communicated the API contract to our technical lead.

We reviewed the DocuSign LOI and are OK to proceed; signing now. Expect signature completed by EOD tomorrow so you can initiate AWS submission on Fri.

One ask: can Redwood include a short paragraph in the LOI stating support SLAs for CPPO-activated subscriptions (24/7 severity 1 escalation path + standard maintenance windows)? Our legal team asked for that to speed procurement review.

Tom
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudResell, Inc.
[Attachment: Signed-Entitlement-CSV.csv]
